name: investment.interest_rates
summary: Four native interest-rate sources with date-group bank coverage.
purpose: Inspect original raw rates and native external-rule details without scaling rates or merging different source models.

parameters.description: Select exactly one original native source.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Verified market/bank timezone; acquisition default GMT+08. Unavailable for rule sources.

limitations: Four original source selectors remain one leaf: market and bank are dated rate observations, expectation-rule and expection are configurations retaining all statuses. Currency filtering is local and exact.

Market/expectation-rule/expection use host general offset collection with verified width1000 and native unique-object totals. Unknown source errors, identity conflicts, changed totals and incomplete scopes retain SDK failure/publication rules.

Bank rowStart/pageSize count descending quote-date groups, not rate rows. Retain every native product row; require fixed native group total, exact group stride/count without cross-page repeats and unique native row tuples. Metadata total_semantics=quote_date_groups distinguishes reported group count from collected product rows.
Raw rateValue/ruleValue units are source-specific and unconfirmed; no scale conversion or derived rate. Native fields, nested values, blank and null values and source order remain unchanged.

Only expection has Get: POST-query /queryFinancialInstRateRuleDetail.json with selected native ruleId, one native response retaining nested detail, without downloading attachments or recursive inquiries.
Public source/date selection is a query scope; offline replays one saved selected source. Get and List are independent; no cross-source fallback or current-plus-history synthesis.
Live does not publish; complete nonempty refresh publishes, failed/empty/incomplete refresh preserves prior capture. No legacy runtime. Durable publication requires explicit sync.
